title: Changes You Made May Not Be Saved
summary: A page tries to say a random farewell as you leave; the browser discards it and substitutes its own generic exit warning.
mechanism: The beforeunload event's returnValue is set to a per-visit farewell and ignored by browsers (custom strings deprecated ~2016), which speak a fixed corporate line instead.
references: Bas Jan Ader, I'm too sad to tell you (1971)
browser vendors' deprecation of custom beforeunload messages (~2016)
